title: Multitask deep network predicts lymph node metastasis and survival from cytology images
summary: CytoNet, a multitask network trained with self-supervised pretraining and supervised fine-tuning on cytology images, predicted lymph node metastasis (AUC 0.831-0.881) and disease-free survival (C index 0.680-0.710) in bladder cancer across cohorts. In cervical cancer it reached AUC 0.847-0.862 for metastasis and C index 0.690-0.709 for survival; in thyroid cancer AUC 0.819-0.855 for metastasis. The multicenter data covered 5273 patients (bladder 1134, cervical 598, thyroid 3541); the authors state that prospective validation is still needed.
ai_technology: CytoNet multitask deep network (self-supervised pretraining, supervised fine-tuning) on cytology images
organization: Sun Yat-sen University; Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital

evidence.tested: Retrospective multicenter cohorts of bladder, cervical and thyroid cancer; performance reported against single-task models and radiological assessment.
evidence.unknown: Exact internal versus external split, prospective performance and clinical utility; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts lymph node metastasis and disease-free survival from cytology images
